title: Colts’ Keenan Allen downgraded to OUT for London game with groin injury

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Colts’ Keenan Allen downgraded to OUT for London game with groin injury
sources.description: Indianapolis Colts wide receiver Keenan Allen was downgraded to OUT with a groin injury and will miss Sunday morning’s affair against the Washington Commanders in London. Colts head coach Shane Steichen initially announced that no players were ruled out, but the six-time pro bowler was limited in practice this week, so there was always an […]
